meta.note: Tidied: unified editor + marketing variables into one semantic set; see README Migration. Re-synced to v35 Contrast (no token value changes).

tokens.name: brand-cobalt
tokens.usage: Electric cobalt, the one brand hue. Logo tile, cover art, marketing primary buttons. In UI code reach for the accent-* tokens, not this.

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: Identity only: the far stop of the logo gradient and the violet aurora glow on marketing pages. Never a UI color (no buttons, text, states).

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Deep navy ink of the logo's camera body and dark brand moments. Never pure black.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Warm off-white paper; the light theme's canvas and the logo's light-ground backdrop.

tokens.name: brand-record
tokens.usage: The small record dot in the logo and the live 'recording' indicator while capturing video. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the canvas viewport behind the user's screenshot, and the marketing page background.

tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: App chrome: icon rail, sidebar panel, header (under glass), modal and palette bodies.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Fill of inputs, slider tracks, segmented/tab tracks, secondary buttons, filmstrip tiles.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: context menu, popovers, cards in the editor, the active segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons and menu items. Put text or text-muted on it, never text-subtle or accent-text.

tokens.name: surface-glass
tokens.usage: Frosted glass for header, dock, toasts, zoom chip. Only over something worth blurring (the canvas, the aurora). Pair with blur-glass-filter and glass-highlight.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the command palette (with blur-scrim).

tokens.name: surface-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip fill. Text on it is text-on-tooltip.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse ground for rare emphasis: on-canvas size labels and cover art. Text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons. AA on every surface-* ground in both themes (lowest: 12.1:1 dark on surface-hover).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: control labels, descriptions, inactive tabs, rail icons on hover. AA on every surface-* ground (lowest 6.2:1).

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: hints, placeholders, meta, timestamps, kbd glyphs. AA on surface-canvas, base, control, raised, hover (lowest 4.7:1 dark on surface-hover).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only. Inactive controls are exempt from WCAG contrast; never use for readable content.

tokens.name: text-on-tooltip
tokens.usage: Text on surface-tooltip (13.4:1 dark, 17:1 light).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The cobalt as a mark: toggle-on track, slider fill and thumb, selection outlines, active rail indicator, progress. Needs 3:1, which it clears on every surface (lowest 3.3:1 dark on surface-hover).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent marks (slider thumb, selected outline).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Cobalt as text or icon: links, active tab/rail label, slider value readouts, toast action. AA on canvas, base, control, raised and accent-soft (lowest 4.8:1).

tokens.name: accent-solid
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons and the checked segmented thumb when it carries on-accent text (white 6.1:1). Dark #5470ff is too light for white text (4.1:1), so solids stay on the deep cobalt in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover (white 5.0:1 dark, 8.2:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-solid-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button active/pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-solid and its hover/pressed states.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted selection ground: active palette row, active rail button, selected preset, active filmstrip ring. Text on it: text or accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on an accent-soft element.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Hairline in cobalt: the header's bottom glow line, selected card borders on marketing pages.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus-visible outline on every interactive element (offset 2px). Clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes (lowest 4.2:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers between sidebar sections, filmstrip top rule, card edges inside panels.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default edge of raised surfaces: menus, popovers, palette, modal, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover edge of secondary buttons and tiles.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edge of controls whose shape must be seen: text inputs, checkboxes, toggle-off track, slider track outline. 3:1 on canvas, base, control and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: The 1px inner top highlight on glass surfaces (inset box-shadow).

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dot-grid dots on the canvas viewport (1px, pitch size-canvas-grid). Deliberately faint: decoration, never information.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon: 'Exported', 'Saved'. AA on every surface (lowest 5.3:1 light on surface-hover).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and toast tint.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon: large export, quota near full. AA on every surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge tint.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon, destructive menu items ('Delete'). AA on every surface (lowest 4.9:1 dark on surface-hover).

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Error badge tint, destructive row hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral system notices ('Model downloading'). Sky, not cobalt, so it never reads as a button. Not for interactive elements.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badge tint.

tokens.name: aurora-cobalt
tokens.usage: Marketing only: top-left radial glow of the fixed aurora behind the page.

tokens.name: aurora-violet
tokens.usage: Marketing only: top-right radial glow of the aurora. The only sanctioned violet besides the logo.

tokens.name: aurora-deep
tokens.usage: Marketing only: bottom radial glow of the aurora.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Marketing frosted card fill (over the aurora), with blur-card-filter and shadow-glass-card.

tokens.name: glass-card-hover
tokens.usage: Marketing card and ghost-button hover fill.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: Marketing card, nav and footer hairlines.

tokens.name: glass-line-hover
tokens.usage: Marketing card and ghost-button hover edge.

tokens.name: mk-text
tokens.usage: Marketing headline and body ink (same as dark text).

tokens.name: mk-text-muted
tokens.usage: Marketing ledes, nav links, card copy. 9.3:1 on surface-canvas.

tokens.name: mk-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Marketing footnotes, footer headings, table meta. 6.4:1 on surface-canvas.

tokens.name: mk-accent
tokens.usage: Marketing accent text: eyebrows, 'New' tags, inline links, the highlighted headline word. 7.1:1 on surface-canvas, 5.0:1 even on the brightest aurora spot.

styles.name: ed-title
styles.usage: Panel headers, modal titles, the selected palette command name.

styles.name: ed-body
styles.usage: Default editor text: inputs, menu items, palette rows, toast copy.

styles.name: ed-body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, toggle labels, active menu item.

styles.name: ed-small
styles.usage: Tabs, segmented options, tooltip text, toast action, control labels (sentence case).

styles.name: ed-caption
styles.sample: Applies to every page in the set
styles.usage: Hints and info text under controls, palette group names.

styles.name: ed-overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section titles and palette section headers. Set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: ed-micro
styles.usage: The one sub-11px style: icon-rail labels and filmstrip page numbers, where width is fixed.

styles.name: ed-value
styles.usage: Numeric readouts: slider values, zoom %, export dimensions. Use tabular-nums.

styles.name: ed-kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard-shortcut chips.

styles.name: ed-code
styles.usage: Code, hex values in color inputs, JSON in the agent panel.

styles.name: ed-version
styles.usage: Version and codename label in the header and what's-new card.

styles.name: mk-display
styles.usage: Landing hero headline only. Scale down with clamp(40px, 6.6vw, 84px).

styles.name: mk-h1
styles.usage: Page heads (pricing, changelog, features). clamp(36px, 5.5vw, 62px).

styles.name: mk-h2
styles.usage: Section headings. clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 42px).

styles.name: mk-h3
styles.usage: Card titles, changelog version headings, pricing tier names.

styles.name: mk-lede
styles.sample: Backgrounds, device frames and AI edits, in your browser.
styles.usage: Hero and page-head subcopy in mk-text-muted. Max 58ch.

styles.name: mk-body
styles.sample: Drop a screenshot, pick a frame, export in seconds.
styles.usage: Marketing paragraphs and card copy.

styles.name: mk-small
styles.usage: Nav links, footer links, table cells, button-adjacent notes.

styles.name: mk-button
styles.usage: Marketing pill buttons.

styles.name: mk-price
styles.usage: Pricing amounts. Use tabular-nums.

styles.name: mk-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow labels above headings, in mk-accent, uppercase.

styles.name: mk-code
styles.usage: Inline code and API snippets on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between segmented options, tab buttons, kbd keys.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in chips, palette row inner padding, tile inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a row, inline control gaps, toast inner gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control-group gap, palette row horizontal padding, menu padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between control groups; header and panel-header side padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sidebar section padding, toast offset from the viewport edge.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Modal padding, marketing card padding (small).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing card padding, gap between pricing cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Marketing grid gaps, footer columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between a marketing heading block and its grid.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing page side gutter at desktop (max).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Marketing section vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd chips, tab/segment thumbs inside a track, timeline clips, tile badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Editor default: buttons, inputs, swatches, tracks, menu rows, filmstrip tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Editor floating surfaces: context menu, toasts, popovers, minimap.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Editor large overlays: command palette, modal, dock; also the logo tile at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-card-sm
tokens.usage: Marketing small cards, changelog entries, inputs on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Marketing feature, pricing and product cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: badges, marketing buttons, toggle track, toggle knob.

shadow.note: Per theme like colors. Marketing shadows are dark-only.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting lift: secondary button hover, filmstrip tiles, swatches.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Small floating chrome: zoom chip, tooltips, timeline playhead label.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Overlays: context menu, command palette, modal, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Editor glass (dock, toast): the 1px inner top highlight plus an outer drop.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-sm
tokens.usage: Editor primary button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Marketing primary pill button.

tokens.name: shadow-glass-card
tokens.usage: Marketing frosted cards.

tokens.name: shadow-product
tokens.usage: The hero product shot and gallery images on marketing pages.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls: icon buttons in the dock and panel headers, segmented control.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default editor control height: buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Prominent editor actions (Export) and marketing inputs.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Editor header height.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Icon rail width.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Contextual sidebar panel width.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, menus, palette rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in the rail and dock.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Empty states and marketing feature icons.

tokens.name: size-canvas-grid
tokens.usage: Canvas viewport dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of editor glass (header, sidebar, dock, toasts).

tokens.name: blur-card
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of marketing frosted cards.

tokens.name: blur-nav
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the sticky marketing nav.

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter of the modal / palette scrim.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, color and border changes; menu and palette open.

tokens.name: duration-smooth
tokens.usage: Panels, toasts sliding in, section collapse, toggle track.

tokens.name: duration-spring
tokens.usage: Small delights only: toggle knob, logo hover, swatch pop. Uses ease-spring.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Marketing scroll reveals.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The house curve for everything that is not a spring.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Slight overshoot for duration-spring delights. Replaced by ease-out under reduced motion.

tokens.name: z-canvas-chrome
tokens.usage: Zoom chip, minimap, dock.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Editor header.

tokens.name: z-whats-new
tokens.usage: What's-new card.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-palette
tokens.usage: Command palette (above modals).

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.
